ingredients:
2 cups jasmine rice
1 cup coconut milk
1 pandan leaf
Salt to taste
4 hard-boiled eggs
1 cucumber (sliced)
100g ikan bilis (anchovies)
100g roasted peanuts
Sambal (chili paste)
instructions:
Step 1: Rinse the jasmine rice until water runs clear
Step 2: Cook rice with coconut milk, pandan leaf, and salt in a rice cooker
Step 3: Fry ikan bilis until crispy, set aside
Step 4: Boil eggs for 10 minutes, peel and cut in half
Step 5: Slice cucumber thinly
Step 6: Prepare sambal by blending chilies, onions, and shrimp paste, then fry until fragrant
Step 7: Serve coconut rice with sambal, eggs, cucumber, ikan bilis, and peanuts on the side
